items.quote: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Speak unto the children of Israel, saying,
items.claim: An instruction to speak to the children of Israel

items.quote: If a woman have conceived seed, and born a man child: then she shall be unclean seven days; according to the days of the separation for her infirmity shall she be unclean.
items.claim: A woman who conceives and bears a male child becomes unclean for seven days according to the days of separation for her infirmity
items.mechanism: according to the days of the separation for her infirmity
